mapper.sql: id, record_date, photo_path, filter_type, memo, is_main, item_tags, look_category, location, like_count, is_liked, is_saved, created_at, user_id, is_shared
mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('outfit_record_seq')
INSERT INTO outfit_record (id, record_date, photo_path, filter_type, memo, is_main, item_tags, look_category, location, created_at, user_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{recordDate}, #{photoPath}, #{filterType}, #{memo}, #{isMain}, #{itemTags}, #{lookCategory}, #{location}, now(), #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.record_date, o.photo_path, o.filter_type, o.memo, o.is_main, o.item_tags, o.look_category, o.location, o.like_count, o.is_liked, o.is_saved, o.created_at, o.user_id, o.is_shared, u.display_name AS author_display_name, u.avatar_path AS author_avatar_path FROM outfit_record o LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.is_shared = 1 ORDER BY o.record_date DESC, o.id DESC
SELECT FROM outfit_record WHERE is_main = 1 AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY record_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM outfit_record WHERE record_date = #{recordDate} ORDER BY is_main DESC, id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM outfit_record WHERE record_date = #{recordDate} ORDER BY is_main DESC, id ASC
SELECT FROM outfit_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date = #{recordDate} ORDER BY is_main DESC, id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM outfit_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date = #{recordDate} ORDER BY is_main DESC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE outfit_record SET is_main = 0 WHERE record_date = #{recordDate}
UPDATE outfit_record SET is_main = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date = #{recordDate}
UPDATE outfit_record SET is_main = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE outfit_record SET like_count = like_count + CASE WHEN #{liked} = 1 AND is_liked = 0 THEN 1 WHEN #{liked} = 0 AND is_liked = 1 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END, is_liked = #{liked} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE outfit_record SET is_saved = #{saved} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE outfit_record SET is_shared = #{shared} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outfit_record WHERE is_saved = 1 ORDER BY record_date DESC, id DESC
